title: Find a record by ID
description:
A customer keeps an append-only file of record IDs in ascending order with no duplicates. Lookups by scanning are too slow.

Write `find_record(ids, target)` that returns the index of `target`, or `-1` if it is not present. Implement binary search yourself. Do not use `list.index` or the `bisect` module for this one.

**Example**

```
find_record([3, 8, 15, 22, 40], 22)   # 3
find_record([3, 8, 15, 22, 40], 9)    # -1
```
hints: Keep two bounds, `low` and `high`, and look at the middle index.
If the middle value is too small, the target can only be to the right, so set `low = mid + 1`. Mirror that for too large.
Loop while `low <= high`. Getting this condition and the `+ 1` / `- 1` right is the whole problem.
